old: the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency published a proposed rule on payment stablecoins implementing the GENIUS Act
new: the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency published a proposed rule on payment stablecoins implementing the GENIUS Act
reason: 原稿 description 寫的是「美國通貨監理局」，英文漏了國別；description 會單獨出現在列表與搜尋結果，沒有 U.S. 就看不出是哪一國的機關（改後 489 字元，上限 500）。

old: to eight categories, which must comprise exclusively, at their core, funds in an account
new: to eight categories; at their core are funds in an account
reason: 原稿是「限於八類，核心是…」；英文把來源的引導語 must comprise exclusively 硬接在「核心」前面，讀成八類只能由這三種資產構成，與下一句的「其餘幾類」自相矛盾，屬事實漂移。

old: and says only one of which would be selected for a final rule:
new: and says only one of them would be selected for a final rule:
reason: 文法錯誤：把來源片語 only one of which 直接嵌進主句；同篇 FAQ 第五題的同一句已寫成 only one of them，兩處應一致。

old: by the OCC, the Federal Reserve or the State payment stablecoin regulator.
new: by the OCC, the Federal Reserve or the State payment stablecoin regulator, as applicable.
reason: 原稿有「視情形」，聯邦公報全文（https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2026/03/02/2026-04089.txt）講擬議 15.12(b)(1)(ii) 的兩處也都以 as applicable 收尾；英文漏掉這個限定，讀成三個機關都可以任意課加。

old: could not increase its outstanding issuance value from the first day of the following month
new: could not issue new payment stablecoins from the first day of the following month
reason: 原稿是「自次月第一日起不得新發行」，擬議 15.41(c)(2) 原文是 is prohibited from issuing any new payment stablecoins；英文寫成「不得增加流通發行面額」，等於贖回多少就可以再發多少，比原稿與來源都寬。

old: charter or licence
new: charter or license
reason: 全篇用美式拼法（program、license、percent），只有這裡是英式 licence；來源原文是 licensing or chartering conditions，同站結尾連結的標題也寫 License。

old: from two U.S. Treasury bureaus
new: from two U.S. Treasury agencies
reason: OFAC 不是財政部的 bureau：財政部官網的 Bureaus 清單（https://home.treasury.gov/about/bureaus）列了 FinCEN、沒有 OFAC，原稿也只寫「財政部轄下」；改成與本篇摘要、小標一致的 agencies。

old: the $5,000 suspicious activity threshold, and OFAC's new sanctions compliance program.
new: the $5,000 suspicious activity reporting threshold, and OFAC's proposed sanctions compliance program.
reason: 原稿是「可疑交易申報門檻」，少了 reporting 會讀成超過 5,000 美元才算可疑；制裁法遵計畫是草案擬新增的，new 讀起來像已經存在，改 proposed（接在上一筆之後 description 為 499 字元，上限 500）。

old: both bureaus of the Department of the Treasury
new: both within the Department of the Treasury
reason: 同上：財政部官網的 Bureaus 清單（https://home.treasury.gov/about/bureaus）沒有 OFAC，聯邦公報 SUMMARY 也只寫 The Department of the Treasury's FinCEN and OFAC；原稿是「財政部轄下的」，bureaus 是譯文多出來而且不正確的細節。

old: the provision numbers four requirements: risk-based policies and risk assessment, independent testing, a designated officer, ongoing training. The written program needs board, equivalent governing body or senior management approval.
new: the proposed text numbers four requirements: internal policies and risk assessment, independent testing, a designated officer, ongoing training. The written program would need board, equivalent body or appropriate senior management approval.
reason: 原稿是「擬議條文編號的四項要件」與「適當高階管理階層」；英文少了 proposed 與 appropriate，needs 又是現在式，整句讀成現行規定。為守 300 字元，把 risk-based 換回原稿的 internal、governing body 縮成 body（改後 298 字元，正文仍有全稱）。

old: issuers would need the technical capability to block, freeze and reject and to comply with lawful orders. OFAC's new 31 CFR part 502 sets five minimum elements
new: issuers would need technical capability to block, freeze and reject and to comply with lawful orders. OFAC's new 31 CFR part 502 would set five minimum elements
reason: 第 502 部是草案擬新增的，sets 讀成已經生效；改 would set，並刪一個 the 讓這一句守在 300 字元內（改後 298 字元）。

old: sit within the Treasury, so this is one joint proposal
new: sit within the Treasury, and this is one joint proposal
reason: 原稿只是並列兩件事，英文加了 so，變成「因為都在財政部底下，所以是聯合提案」的因果，原稿與來源都沒有這個說法。

old: with no final rule in sight
new: with no final rule found
reason: 原稿「未見定案規則」說的是查詢結果裡沒有；in sight 是「看不出會來」的預測語氣，多出原稿沒有的判斷。

old: The proposed 1033.210 splits effective into two halves
new: The proposed 1033.210 splits "effective" into two halves
reason: 原稿的「有效」帶引號，是在談這個字怎麼被拆成兩半；英文拿掉引號後 splits effective into 讀不通。

old: The risk assessment has to evaluate
new: The risk assessment would have to evaluate
reason: 這是擬議 1033.210(b)(1) 的內容；單句的 has to 讀起來像現行義務，改回 would。

old: The program must be written and must be approved by
new: The program would have to be written and approved by
reason: 擬議 1033.210(d) 尚未生效；同一句後半已經是 would also have to，前半的 must 讀成現行規定。

old: and those capabilities, policies and procedures must account for
new: and those capabilities, policies and procedures would have to account for
reason: 同一句前半是 would require，後半的 must 讀成現行義務；擬議 1033.240(a) 尚未生效。

old: The deadline is a suspicious activity report (SAR) within 30 calendar days after initial detection; where no suspect is identified on the day of detection, the issuer may take an additional 30 calendar days to identify one, but in no case may reporting be delayed
new: A suspicious activity report (SAR) would be due within 30 calendar days after initial detection; where no suspect is identified on the day of detection, the issuer could take an additional 30 calendar days to identify one, but in no case could reporting be delayed
reason: The deadline is a suspicious activity report 文法不通，整句又全是現在式，讀成現行的申報期限；擬議 1033.320(b)(3) 尚未生效，改 would／could，數字與條件不動。

old: and the Travel Rule apply as well
new: and the Travel Rule would apply as well
reason: 紀錄規則與旅行規則對這類發行人的適用是草案擬議的，apply 讀成已經適用。

old: knowingly being defined in the proposal as having actual knowledge, or should have known
new: knowingly being defined in the proposal to mean that a person has actual knowledge, or should have known
reason: as having actual knowledge, or should have known 文法不通；改用擬議 502.301 定義句自己的句型（means that a person has actual knowledge, or should have known），意思不變。

old: The ACTION section reads joint proposed rule
new: The ACTION section reads Joint proposed rule
reason: reads 後面是逐字引欄位值，聯邦公報印的是「ACTION: Joint proposed rule.」（大寫 J）；同組其他三篇引 ACTION 欄也都照原文大小寫。

old: the stamp for filing with the Office of the Federal Register for public inspection reads
new: the stamp for filing for public inspection reads
reason: 原稿只寫「送存公眾閱覽的戳記」，戳記原文也只有 Filed 4–9–26; 8:45 am，沒有寫送存對象；with the Office of the Federal Register 是譯文比原稿多出、研究紀錄的來源引文也沒有的細節。

old: On April 7, 2026 the FDIC Board approved a proposal
new: On April 7, 2026 the board of the U.S. Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) approved a proposal
reason: 原稿 description 寫的是「美國聯邦存款保險公司（FDIC）理事會」，英文把國別與機關全名都省了；description 會單獨露出，同組 OCC、NCUA、FinCEN/OFAC 三篇的 description 都有機關全名或國別。

old: why it would count the deposit insurance on reserve deposits at the issuer rather than at each stablecoin holder
new: why it would count the deposit insurance on reserve deposits as the issuer's rather than each stablecoin holder's
reason: count … at the issuer 不是英文的說法，description 又是單獨露出的一句；count … as the issuer's 才對得上原稿的「算在發行人身上」（兩筆都套用後 description 為 484 字元）。

old: reaches every insured institution holding such deposits.
new: reaches every insured depository institution with such deposits.
reason: 全批統一用語是 insured depository institution，原稿這裡也是全稱「受保存款機構」；摘要是全文第一次出現這個詞，不能先用縮略的 insured institution（holding 改 with 省 3 字元，改後 299 字元）。

old: A significant redemption request is defined as
new: A significant redemption request would be defined as
reason: 這是擬議定義，10% 與 24 小時都還在徵詢意見；is defined 單句讀成現行定義，改回 would。

old: in the liquidation proceedings described in section 11 of the GENIUS Act, and those claims would rank senior to
new: in the insolvency proceedings described in section 11 of the GENIUS Act, and those claims would rank senior to
reason: 聯邦公報原文是 in any insolvency proceedings described under section 11 of the Act（https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2026/04/10/2026-06974.txt），第 11 條管的就是 insolvency proceedings；liquidation 是另一個法律概念，英文應照來源用語。

old: in the liquidation proceedings described in section 11 of the GENIUS Act, and those claims would rank ahead of
new: in the insolvency proceedings described in section 11 of the GENIUS Act, and those claims would rank ahead of
reason: 同上一筆（FAQ 第五題的同一句）：來源原文是 insolvency proceedings described under section 11，不是 liquidation。

old: creditors in liquidation proceedings; all four panels are proposed.
new: creditors in insolvency proceedings; all four panels are proposed.
reason: 圖說與正文同一個用語：來源原文是 insolvency proceedings（research 的複本另交一筆）。

old: creditors in liquidation proceedings; all four panels are proposed.
new: creditors in insolvency proceedings; all four panels are proposed.
reason: 圖說在 research 的逐字複本，與 pack 那一筆同改：來源原文是 insolvency proceedings。

old: Insured to the issuer
new: Insured to the issuer, not holders
reason: 原稿主圖標語是「保的是發行人，不是持有人」，英文只剩前半，單看主圖會讀成「穩定幣有保險」，正好是這篇要澄清的誤解；補回 not holders（34 字元，check_article 對 en 的上限約 44 字元，label() 在 1400px 寬內不會縮字；主圖需重畫）。

old: On May 18, 2026 the National Credit Union Administration's supplemental proposed rule
new: On May 18, 2026 the U.S. National Credit Union Administration's supplemental proposed rule
reason: 原稿 description 寫的是「美國 NCUA」，英文漏了國別；description 會單獨露出，沒有 U.S. 就看不出是哪一國的機關（改後 469 字元，上限 500）。

old: and from paying any interest or yield for holding it.
new: and from paying any interest or yield for holding them.
reason: it 沒有單數先行詞（前面是複數的 payment stablecoins），文法錯誤；改後 299 字元，仍在 300 內。

old: Amends the share insurance rules, tokenized shares included
new: Would amend the share insurance rules, tokenized shares included
reason: 補充提案只是擬修正股金保險規則，Amends 把它說成已經修正；這一格的動詞直接寫成既成事實，改回 would。

old: A shortfall must be reported to the NCUA on the day it occurs, and new issuance is prohibited immediately
new: A shortfall would have to be reported to the NCUA on the day it occurs, and new issuance would be prohibited immediately
reason: 這一段只有第一句有 would，後面全是 must／is 的現在式，單句讀起來像已生效的規則；FAQ 同一內容有「none of it is in force」收尾，正文這段沒有，改回 would。

old: the issuer must begin liquidating reserve assets and redeeming, and may not charge a redemption fee at any time during the liquidation
new: the issuer would have to begin liquidating reserve assets and redeeming, and could not charge a redemption fee at any time during the liquidation
reason: 同上一筆：擬議 706.202(g)(3) 尚未生效，must／may not 讀成現行義務，改回 would／could。

old: The redemption policy must state that
new: The redemption policy would have to state that
reason: 同上：擬議 706.203(b)(1) 尚未生效，單句的 must 讀成現行義務。

old: the period is automatically extended to seven calendar days, and the NCUA may extend it in its discretion as well
new: the period would be automatically extended to seven calendar days, and the NCUA could extend it in its discretion as well
reason: 同上：擬議 706.203(c)(1) 與 (c)(5) 尚未生效，is extended／may extend 讀成現行規定，改回 would／could。

old: irrespective of an intention or representation that they are.
new: irrespective of an intention or representation that they are: a product that does not meet the statutory definition of an account will not be an insurable share account.
reason: 原稿寫的是「不符合法定帳戶定義的代幣化負債就不是可保的股金帳戶」，英文只留了來源的前一句、漏了判準；補上來源緊接的下一句（https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/full_text/text/2026/05/18/2026-09915.txt：If a product does not meet the statutory definition of an「account」…）。

old: A reading index to this site's 2026 crypto news explainers
new: An index to this site's 2026 crypto news explainers
reason: 第 6 類（為下一筆騰字數）：description 上限 500 字元、現為 488；ZH 沒有 reading 一詞。這一筆必須排在下一筆之前套用，否則下一筆會超過上限被拒。

old: the end of the MiCA transitional period and the payment rules
new: the end of the MiCA transitional period and where MiCA meets the payment rules
reason: 第 1 類：ZH 是「MiCA 過渡期與支付規則的銜接」；現譯會被讀成「MiCA 過渡期與支付規則（兩者）的結束」，支付規則並沒有結束。用語與本篇 [38] 小標一致。

old: news like this is to tell apart what kind of document it is
new: news like this is to work out what kind of document it is
reason: 第 6 類：tell apart 要接兩個以上的對象（tell A and B apart），後面接 what kind of document it is 不成句；這是全篇的主旨句，會被讀成機翻。

old: reading regulatory news is to tell apart what kind of document it is
new: reading regulatory news is to work out what kind of document it is
reason: 第 6 類：同上（tell apart 的用法錯誤）；image caption，research 有逐字複本，另交一筆。

old: reading regulatory news is to tell apart what kind of document it is
new: reading regulatory news is to work out what kind of document it is
reason: 第 6 類：與 pack 的 block8.image.caption 同一筆（caption 的逐字複本）。

old: and start by telling apart what kind of document it is
new: and start by working out what kind of document it is
reason: 第 6 類：同上（tell apart 的用法錯誤）。

old: at the centre of this set
new: at the center of this set
reason: 第 6 類：全批英文用美式拼法（analyzed、program、organizational、labor），只有這裡是英式 centre；歐盟篇的 authorised 是照 ESMA 原文，不在此限。

old: the joint interpretation of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
new: the joint interpretation of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
reason: 第 1 類（輕）：ZH 寫「美國證券交易委員會」；索引橫跨四個法域，首次出現不標國別，非美國讀者分不出是哪一國的機關。機關自稱即 U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission。

old: Then come the proposals: the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)
new: Then come the proposals: in the United States, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)
reason: 第 1 類（輕）：ZH 是「美國的通貨監理局…」，譯文把「美國的」丟了；前一句講台灣，緊接著不標國別會斷線。

new: published by the Financial Services Agency (FSA) is commissioned research

old: The joint SEC and CFTC interpretation
new: The joint U.S. SEC and CFTC interpretation

new: The U.S. proposals of the OCC, the FDIC, the NCUA, FinCEN and OFAC, and the SEC
reason: 第 1 類（輕）：表格 ZH 是「美國 OCC、FDIC…的提案」，同上。

old: into seven kinds, each kind of which has to obtain the license and license certificate of the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) separately;
new: into seven kinds, and a business has to obtain the license and license certificate of the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) separately for each kind;

old: the FSC is to consult the Central Bank for its consent before granting one
new: the FSC is to consult the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) and obtain its consent before granting one
reason: 第 4、5 類：索引全篇沒有出現中央銀行的官方英文全名（https://www.cbc.gov.tw/en/ 自稱 Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)）；「會商…同意」與台灣篇 [40][55] 一樣寫成 consult … and obtain its consent，不比原稿弱。

old: records approval on July 18, 2025 at its end
new: records at its end that it was approved on July 18, 2025
reason: 第 6 類：at its end 掛在句尾會被讀成「在 2025-07-18 的結尾核准」；ZH 是「公法原文末尾記著…核准」。

old: redemption for the institutions it supervises

old: プレスリリース自体に記された金額はひとつだけで、NVIDIAニュースルーム版は「MediaTekが発行する転換社債に35億ドルを追加出資した」と記し、MediaTekの中国語版プレスリリースも同じ金額を、MediaTekが発行した無担保海外転換社債（ECB）への米ドル35億元の出資と記しています。どちらの発表文にも発行条件は記されていません。
new: プレスリリース自体に記された金額はひとつだけです。MediaTekの中国語版プレスリリースの表現では、NVIDIAは「MediaTekが発行する海外転換社債（ECB）に35億米ドルを出資した」とされており、そこには発行条件は一切記されていません。
reason: 三個問題：一、ZH 只引聯發科技中文新聞稿那一句，譯文自己多生出一句 NVIDIA 英文稿的引文；二、「追加出資」與來源不符，NVIDIA 英文原文是「NVIDIA has also invested $3.5 billion in convertible bonds issued by MediaTek.」（also≠追加），會讓讀者以為先前已有一筆投資；三、「米ドル35億元」在日文不成立（元不是美元的單位）。
